metadata.description: Move's skills for recruiters: prep and run the intake, write it up, and send the Friday updates.

plugins.name: move-intake
plugins.description: Prepare for and run a hiring intake as an upside-down triangle (business, team, role, candidate), then turn the transcript into intake notes, a JD, a recruiter screen and a next-steps checklist.

plugins.name: move-reporting
plugins.description: Friday reporting for embedded recruiters: the end of week update for each hiring manager, and the roll-up for the client's Head of Talent.
